faq.q: Why does a page come out blank or get flagged as scanned?
faq.a: This tool reads the text layer a PDF already contains; it does not do OCR. A page that is just a photo or scan of paper has no text layer, so nothing can be extracted from it. When a selected page returns no characters, the tool lists it by number and shows a link to the OCR tool at /tools/ocr, which reads text from the image instead. The per-page character counts make it easy to spot which pages are text and which are images.

faq.q: How are paragraphs and line breaks decided?
faq.a: Characters are grouped into lines by their vertical position on the page, and each line is read left to right, with a space inserted wherever there is a real gap between words. In the default Paragraphs mode a blank line is added when the vertical gap between two lines is clearly larger than the normal line spacing, which is how a new paragraph usually looks. You can instead choose Line breaks only to keep every line, or flow each page into a single paragraph. Rotated pages are normalised first so they read in the right order.

faq.q: Can it read Hindi, Devanagari or other non-English text?
faq.a: Yes, as long as the PDF stores that text as real characters with proper Unicode mapping in its fonts. PDFs keep text as Unicode, so Devanagari, Tamil, Bengali and other scripts come through unchanged. If a document was built from images of text, or uses fonts with no Unicode mapping, the characters may come out garbled or empty — that is a property of the file, and OCR is the fallback for it.

faq.q: How do page ranges, page separators and large files work?
faq.a: Type a range such as 1-3, 5, 8-10 to pull only those pages; leave it blank for the whole document. The Page separators option inserts a labelled divider before each page's text. Large PDFs are processed one page at a time with a progress bar, and a Cancel button stops the job and keeps whatever was already read. You can also rejoin words split by a hyphen at the end of a line. The result sits in an editable box you can copy or download as a .txt file.
